citations.quote:
ACME Code §14-305 — Fence height, front yard
Published rule DF-1, version DF-1@1.
Applies to: Residential deck or fence (deck_fence).
Applies when: location = front; structure_kind = fence.
Checks: Fence height (ft).
Operator: must not be more than.
Threshold: 4.

answer.text: The published ACME Code limits a fence in the front yard of a residential lot to 4 ft.

citations.quote:
ACME Code §14-306 — Fence height, side and rear yard
Published rule DF-2, version DF-2@1.
Applies to: Residential deck or fence (deck_fence).
Applies when: location = side_rear; structure_kind = fence.
Checks: Fence height (ft).
Operator: must not be more than.
Threshold: 6.

answer.text: For the side and the rear yard of the same residential lot the published limit is 6 ft.
This permit type is the one for a residential deck, fence or other yard structure, and it is reviewed at the counter.
